name: Circle USYC
description: Circle USYC is a regulated DeFi platform with permissioned smart contracts, on-chain transparency, and customizable investment strategies for optimized risk-reward profiles.  USYC is a Hashnote product which provides exposure to short duration US Treasuries and Reverse Repo on US Treasuries

methodology.Fees: All yields generated from USYC backing assets, reported at each price report.
methodology.Revenue: Performance fee taken from the yield, paid to the USYC manager as newly minted USYC.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Performance fee taken from the yield, paid to the USYC manager as newly minted USYC.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yield left for USYC holders after the performance fee, accrued through the USYC price.

Fees.Assets Yields: Yield of the backing assets that goes to USYC holders.
Fees.Performance Fees: Performance fee minted as USYC at each price report, valued at the report's price.

Revenue.Performance Fees: All of the performance fee goes to the USYC manager.

ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees: All of the performance fee goes to the USYC manager.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Yield of the backing assets that goes to USYC holders.
